person.name: Allu Arjun
person.bio:
Allu Arjun is an Indian actor who primarily works in Telugu cinema. Born in Chennai on April 8, 1982, he began his career as a child artist before making his lead-actor debut in Gangotri (2003). He rose to prominence with his roles in Arya (2004) and the action films Bunny (2005) and Desamuduru (2007). In 2008, he starred in the romantic drama Parugu, for which he received his first Filmfare Award for Best Actor – Telugu.

Arjun subsequently starred in successful films such as Aarya 2 (2009), Julayi (2012), Race Gurram (2014), S/O Satyamurthy (2015), Sarrainodu (2016), and Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo (2020). His performance in Pushpa: The Rise (2021) brought him greater recognition outside Telugu cinema and earned him the National Film Award for Best Actor, making him the first Telugu actor to receive the award in that category.

Arjun is also known for his dancing. He has received several accolades throughout his career, including Filmfare, Nandi, and SIIMA Awards. Beyond acting, Arjun is involved in the film-exhibition business. He is associated with AAA Cinemas and has also been involved with Allu Cinemas, which was established by his father, Allu Aravind.

titles.title: Pushpa: The Rise
titles.overview: As Pushpa, a labourer, rises in the world of red sandalwood smuggling, he ends up making many enemies. However, violence ensues when the police try to topple his illegal business.

titles.title: Pushpa 2 - The Rule
titles.overview: As his smuggling empire grows, a brazen Pushpa longs for power and respect on his vengeful journey, while facing old rivals and new.

titles.title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
titles.overview: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son.

titles.title: Yevadu
titles.overview: Satya is given a different face after he suffers burn-related injuries. After being released from the hospital, he deals with the murderer of his lover Deepti. But his new face has given him new foes.

titles.title: Race Gurram
titles.overview: Ram and Lakshman, aka Lucky, are brothers who are polar opposites in nature. Their mother wishes to see them united.

titles.title: Son of Satyamurthy
titles.overview: The son of a rich businessman struggles to save his father's wealth after his demise. However, he faces many challenges when he becomes the sole breadwinner of his family.

titles.title: DJ: Duvvada Jagannadham
titles.overview: A righteous young man who helps everyone gain their rightful justice, gets recruited as an undercover agent to work on a high profile case that involves a crime lord working for a corrupt minister who also happens to be the father of his romantic interest.

titles.title: Aarya 2
titles.overview: Two young boys staying together at an orphanage become friends. One of them is adopted by a wealthy family and grows up to become the owner of a software company. He provides employment for his friend, but when they both fall in love with the same young woman, conflict emerges.

titles.title: Sarrainodu
titles.overview: Ghana, a jobless young man who left military to bring justice to the society, whiling away timing beating up goons. Life takes a turn when he brushes the shady Vairam Dhanush the wrong way.

titles.title: Aarya
titles.overview: Aarya is a happy-go-lucky young man who goes to college. When he falls in love with Geetha at first sight, he proposes to her - in front of her boyfriend Ajay, who recently also proposed to her. She bluntly refuses, but ...

titles.title: Julayi
titles.overview: An intelligent young man and a timid cop team up to catch a criminal who wants revenge after a foiled bank robbery.

titles.title: Naa Peru Surya - Naa Illu India
titles.overview: Despite having serious anger management issues, Surya, an Indian Army officer is a brilliant officer but when anger takes control of him he is impossible to subdue. In spite of this issue, he achieves his goal of serving the country by overcoming the hurdles.
